scripts.format: uv run ruff format && prettier --write "dashboard/**/*.{ts,tsx,html}" "e2e/**/*.ts" eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json lefthook.yml
scripts.check: npm run check:python && npm run check:ts && npm run e2e
